common_context: Use only the supplied visible question, paragraphs and table.
Do not use hidden gold answers, expected references, hidden units, UID branches or expected programs.
Return exactly one JSON object with keys answer, numeric_value, unit, evidence_refs, unknown and clarification.
evidence_refs must use only visible P<n>, TABLE:C<n> or TABLE:R<n>:C<n> identifiers.
If required visible evidence is absent, set unknown=true, answer="UNKNOWN", numeric_value=null, unit="UNKNOWN", evidence_refs=[] and provide a nonempty clarification.

direct_answer.instruction: Answer directly from the visible evidence. Apply the requested typed operation when the question requires one.

neutral_typed_tool.instruction: Construct a visible-only typed operand list and deterministic program, then execute it with the shared safe calculator before answering.

verified_role_type_binding.instruction: Use the same visible typed program and shared safe calculator, then verify entity, row, period, role, type and unit bindings before delivery.

stop_rules: Stop before generation when the visible baseline explains or contract-bounds every natural V2 residual.
Reject before model loading at physical attempt 37 or when the conservative token projection exceeds 240000.
Stop an attempt after a complete JSON object or at 512 new tokens; never silently retry outside the persistent ledger.
Do not run confirmation, judge, training or new-source validation in this candidate.
